key_insight: V-DUGKS reformulates compressible flow simulation with vectorial coupled distributions and second-order Hermite equilibria, enabling adjustable Prandtl number and more stable, efficient continuum-flow computations.
engineering_relevance: The scheme offers a practical CFD framework for accurate shock, vortex, and multi-dimensional compressible-flow simulations with improved timestep efficiency and reduced sensitivity to reference temperature.
method: Coupled mass, momentum, and total-energy distributions in a vectorial kinetic formulation
Use separate relaxation processes for momentum and energy transport to tune Prandtl number
Employ second-order Hermite truncation with fourth-order Gauss-Hermite quadrature and finite-volume characteristic fluxes
evidence_signal: Validated on shock-tube, Shu-Osher, two-dimensional Riemann, and three-dimensional Taylor-Green vortex tests, where it shows accuracy, robustness, and about 2.2–2.9× speed-up on the 3D vortex case.
watch_item: Performance and robustness may depend on the chosen compact velocity set, quadrature accuracy, and careful implementation of the finite-volume flux and collision steps.
paper_title: Vectorial discrete unified gas kinetic scheme for continuum compressible flows
